title: Void Crystal Orb
text: Craft at an Arcane Assembly Bench.

The central trash slot and item/fluid ports immediately destroy all input. There is no temporary storage or undo. Resonance nodes and compatible pipes from other mods can insert, but nothing can be extracted. A terminal-bound node turns black and is named Void; unbound nodes remain red.
Accepts one Intake and one Speed Upgrade. Intake follows the host's rate, directions and filters; direct input and resonance bypass its filter and intake allowance.
Shattering a Void Crystal Orb by stepping on it is risky.
